mock_only.warning: The X-Mock-Scenario request header, POST /__mock/reset and GET /__mock/scenarios exist only in the local mock. NEVER send them to production.

public_response_contract.note: coverage is an open dict. These are the authoritative field names; the mock implements them for success, failed and no_reports. 'returned' is NOT part of the contract and must not be relied on. Mock-specific omissions (e.g. searched_from/to are always null because the mock does not search a window) are intentional and documented in README/API.

scenarios.name: success
expect: Each requested symbol yields last_n reports with usable files.
summary.downloaded counts newly created reports; a later new-key job reports them as cached.

scenarios.name: partial
expect: At least one report has report_period=null and period_source=unknown with a warning.
Usable files are still present and downloadable; a client MUST NOT discard them.

scenarios.name: failed
expect: GET /api/v1/fetch-jobs/{id} returns HTTP 200 while job status is failed.
Each symbol has error.code=source_unavailable and error.retryable=true.

scenarios.name: no_reports
expect: The source search completed normally but matched nothing.

scenarios.name: queue_full
expect: POST returns 429 with a Retry-After header and problem code=queue_full.
No job is created; retry later.

scenarios.name: slow
expect: The queued/running phase is stretched by a finite budget (default 8000 ms).
A client with a shorter overall timeout must give up in bounded time (no infinite wait).
The job still reaches a terminal state eventually.

idempotency.effective_defaults: Omitted last_n (4), refresh (false) and forms_by_market are filled with their effective values before the request hash is compared.
idempotency.retry_rule: On a network timeout retry the SAME key with the SAME body; never generate a new key for the same logical action.

422: invalid_request (validation, unknown field, unsupported form, malformed JSON, unknown mock scenario)

test_cases.expect: 202 -> succeeded; 2 items; checksum matches; ETag matches
observes queued then running then a terminal status

steps: submit key K again while pending -> 202 same job_id
submit key K again -> 200 same job_id

test_cases.expect: terminal partial; unknown-period warning; files still usable
HTTP 200, job status failed, retryable error

steps: poll with an overall timeout shorter than the slow budget
test_cases.expect: client stops in bounded time and reports a timeout; no infinite loop

file_notes.bytes: The file endpoint returns real fixture bytes, not JSON.
file_notes.content_disposition: Readable, deterministic: {market}_{symbol}_{doc_type}_{report_period|filing_date|unknown}_{report_id}.{ext}; historical (non-current artifact) appends artifact_id. Also carries filename*=UTF-8''. Do not rely on any fixed legacy filename.
file_notes.mime: CN/HK reports are application/pdf, US reports are text/html in the mock
file_notes.synthetic: All mock fixture files are clearly marked MOCK and are NOT real financial information.

progress_contract.symbols_total: Normalized submitted-symbol count, correct from queued onward (not derived from persisted results).
